_comment: Where to draw CooL4 signal info (dm_signal_info_msgs) on the map. Each approach (方路) is drawn at 'distance_m' from the intersection centre, along the bearing (degrees clockwise from north) of the leg. Vehicle signal IDs are drawn on their inbound approach (high nibble); pedestrian IDs (low nibble 0) on the crosswalk of the crossed approach. Bearings come from the Lanelet2 traffic lights of each crossroad; see docs/DMProtocols/CooL4/SignalInfo.
